visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and round glasses wearing a blue t-shirt with a subtle graphic sits in an indoor setting. Behind him is a bright window showing lush green trees. A brown tabby cat lies resting on a white shelf near the window. (2) The scene cuts to a young woman with long dark hair tied back, smiling broadly and talking directly to the camera. Her eyes are bright and expressive, and she gestures slightly while speaking. The background remains the same indoor environment with soft, natural daylight. (3) A sequence of shots shows different cats in an office-like setting. A tabby cat is seen sitting on the floor; then an orange and white cat is curled up sleeping on a chair under a wooden desk. A desk leg is visible, wrapped in sisal rope for scratching. (4) The brown tabby cat walks confidently across a light wood floor from a doorway towards the camera. The woman is partially visible in the frame, watching the cat. (5) The tortoiseshell cat is shown sitting near a cat flap in a white door, looking curiously into the room. Later, a white and grey cat peeks its head around a door frame, staring at the camera with large green eyes. (6) The woman continues to talk and laugh as various cats appear and move around the room, sometimes ignoring her calls and sometimes approaching. The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring white brand text and a logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male voice speaking at a moderate pace with a friendly tone. An upbeat acoustic guitar track with a steady, major-key rhythm begins as background music. (2) A female voice enters with high pitch and energetic arousal, laughing frequently. The speech-to-music ratio is high, with the BGM providing a bright atmosphere. (3) A rhythmic tapping sound is heard, likely the speaker tapping on the floor to call the cat. A short 'pop' sound effect highlights the appearance of a cat. (4) The female voice calls out a cat's name with a melodic, rising intonation. Each time a cat enters the room, a light cartoon 'ding' or 'boing' SFX is triggered. (5) Toward the end, multiple female exclamations occur as several cats enter the room simultaneously, followed by a final stinger sound as the BGM fades for the brand logo.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Setup -> Experiment Trial 1 -> Experiment Trial 2 -> Unexpected Results -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To conduct a humorous experiment testing whether a specific cat (Deko) will respond to its name being called from various distances. The humor arises from other cats mistakenly responding to the call instead of the target cat.
